# Requirement

- Requirement ID: REQ-502
- Title: Add transaction amount range filtering
- Source: Phase 3C tester loopback demo
- Date: 2026-08-15

## Objective

Add amount range filtering.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Minimum and maximum bounds are inclusive.
- Rows below minimum are excluded.
- Rows above maximum are excluded.
- Missing bounds are treated as open-ended.
